svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Istio service mesh with sidecars subtitle: Inside the mesh every hop runs over mutual TLS between Envoy proxies, from the ingress to the egress gateway; istiod configures them all # Top to bottom, so the six hops fit an 880px README column at full label size (orrery review): # the Istio namespaces stack down the left, the shop namespace sits beside them. direction: down layout: { merge: false, spacing: compact } legend: solid: Requests dotted: Config and certificates (xDS) groups: cluster: { type: k8s:cluster, label: Kubernetes cluster } # Gateways run in their own namespaces, apart from the control plane, as the Istio install guide recommends. ingress-ns: { type: k8s:namespace, label: Namespace istio-ingress, in: cluster } system-ns: { type: k8s:namespace, label: Namespace istio-system, in: cluster } shop: { type: k8s:namespace, label: Namespace shop, in: cluster } fe-pod: { type: box, label: Pod frontend, icon: k8s:pod, in: shop } cart-pod: { type: box, label: Pod cart, icon: k8s:pod, in: shop } co-pod: { type: box, label: Pod checkout, icon: k8s:pod, in: shop } egress-ns: { type: k8s:namespace, label: Namespace istio-egress, in: cluster } nodes: users: { icon: generic:users, label: Users } ingress: { icon: logos:envoy-icon, label: Ingress gateway, note: Terminates TLS, in: ingress-ns } # Each app container sits beside its sidecar (align), so a pod reads as one unit across the flow. fe-proxy: { icon: logos:envoy-icon, label: Envoy sidecar, note: istio-proxy, in: fe-pod } fe: { icon: generic:container, label: frontend, note: App container, in: fe-pod, align: fe-proxy } cart-proxy: { icon: logos:envoy-icon, label: Envoy sidecar, note: istio-proxy, in: cart-pod } cart: { icon: generic:container, label: cart, note: App container, in: cart-pod, align: cart-proxy } co-proxy: { icon: logos:envoy-icon, label: Envoy sidecar, note: istio-proxy, in: co-pod } co: { icon: generic:container, label: checkout, note: App container, in: co-pod, align: co-proxy } istiod: { icon: si:istio, label: istiod, note: "Discovery, config, CA", in: system-ns } egress: { icon: logos:envoy-icon, label: Egress gateway, note: Single exit point, in: egress-ns } psp: { icon: generic:payment, label: Payment provider, note: External API } edges: - users -> ingress: HTTPS - ingress -> fe-proxy: mTLS # The app talks to its own sidecar over localhost; the iptables redirect sends every call through it. - fe-proxy -- fe: localhost - fe-proxy -> cart-proxy, co-proxy: mTLS - cart-proxy -- cart - co-proxy -- co - co-proxy -> egress: mTLS - egress -> psp: HTTPS # Laid out ingress -> istiod -> egress so the control plane sits between the two gateways, beside # the shop namespace; the arrowheads stay on the proxies. - { from: ingress, to: istiod, arrow: start, line: dotted, label: xDS } - istiod ..> egress: xDS - { from: istiod, to: shop, line: dotted, label: xDS, constraint: false }

svg.title: Istio service mesh with sidecars
svg.desc: Istio service mesh with sidecars. 11 components in 8 groups. Connections: Users to Ingress gateway (HTTPS); Ingress gateway to Envoy sidecar (mTLS); Envoy sidecar to frontend (localhost); Envoy sidecar to Envoy sidecar (mTLS); Envoy sidecar to Envoy sidecar (mTLS); Envoy sidecar to cart; Envoy sidecar to checkout; Envoy sidecar to Egress gateway (mTLS); Egress gateway to Payment provider (HTTPS); Ingress gateway to istiod (xDS); istiod to Egress gateway (xDS); istiod to Namespace shop (xDS).

text.tspan: Inside the mesh every hop runs over mutual TLS between Envoy proxies, from the ingress to the egress gateway; istiod configures them all
